name: Spotlight AI Search Visibility
author: Spotlight

sections.description:
This plugin connects your WordPress site to your Spotlight account and allows you to publish AI-optimized content directly into your blog.

The content is designed to improve how large language models (LLMs) understand, select, and cite your pages in AI-powered search experiences.

Built for AI search, not just traditional SEO

Unlike classic SEO plugins, this plugin focuses on AI search visibility, including:

  • ChatGPT
  • Google AI Overviews
  • Google AI Mode
  • Gemini
  • Perplexity
  • Claude
  • Microsoft Copilot
  • Grok

How it works

  • Securely connects to your Spotlight account
  • Pushes content from Spotlight directly into WordPress
  • Automatically applies optimal schema markup to each page
  • Improves entity clarity, topical focus, and citation readiness

No manual formatting or schema configuration required.

Key features

  • One-click publishing from Spotlight to WordPress
  • Content optimized for AI search and LLMs
  • Automatic schema markup (Article, FAQ, HowTo, and others where relevant)
  • Works alongside existing SEO plugins
  • Designed for publishers, marketers, and content teams

Who this plugin is for

  • Publishers who want their content cited by AI assistants
  • SEO teams adapting to AI-powered search
  • WordPress sites investing in AEO and GEO strategies
  • Brands using Spotlight to improve AI visibility

Does this guarantee citations?

No plugin can guarantee citations by AI systems.
This plugin helps optimize content for AI search, increasing the likelihood that your pages are selected and referenced by LLMs.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the spotlight-ai-search-visibility folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → Spotlight AI Search Visibility to get your API key
  4. Copy the API key and use it in your Spotlight dashboard
sections.faq:
Does this replace my SEO plugin?

No. It complements traditional SEO plugins by focusing specifically on AI-powered search and LLM visibility.

Do I need a Spotlight account?

Yes. A Spotlight account is required to publish AI-optimized content using this plugin.

Does this guarantee my site will be cited by ChatGPT or Google AI?

No. AI platforms control citations. This plugin helps optimize content structure and clarity to increase citation likelihood.

How do I get my API key?

Go to WordPress Admin → Settings → Spotlight AI Search Visibility. Your API key will be displayed there. You can copy it or regenerate it if needed.

What schema types are supported?

The plugin supports Article, BlogPosting, NewsArticle, HowTo, FAQPage, Product, Review, Recipe, VideoObject, and Organization schema types.

Is my content secure?

Yes, the plugin uses API key authentication. Only requests with a valid API key can create posts on your site.

Can I customize the schema markup?

Yes, the plugin provides a filter spotlight_ai_visibility_schema that allows you to modify the schema output.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Fixed: List items with continuation lines (indented text) now properly stay together in the same list block
  • Fixed: Indented continuation text after list items is now correctly recognized as part of the list item
  • Improved: List parsing now handles multi-line list items correctly

1.0.2

  • Fixed: Consecutive numbered list items now stay in the same block instead of being split into separate blocks
  • Fixed: Empty lines between list items no longer break the list prematurely
  • Improved: List parsing now peeks ahead to determine if list should continue

1.0.1

  • Fixed: Ordered lists now display correct numbering (1, 2, 3…) instead of all items showing as “1”
  • Improved: Updated to use modern WordPress Gutenberg nested list-item blocks

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Spotlight integration
  • AI-optimized content publishing
  • Automatic schema markup
  • Gutenberg block format support
  • One-click publishing from Spotlight
